items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: In fact, Foss was with the Dawn of Busters, Al White and all of them.

ctx.x: Well, Jerry Aspinel was out there for a while, but I don't know. He used to play with the Dawn Busters too.
In fact, Foss was with the Dawn of Busters, Al White and all of them.

Did you ever play with Andre and Le Fay? Yeah, he played fine piano. I never really get to hear him except on some homemade record. Yeah, he was real good. He was playing with Johnny Dutroy for a long time. And what about Howard Reed? Did you ever play with him? A trumpet player? No. A trumpet player. See, I may have a good... Yeah, he played with Foss for a while. Yeah, yeah. That's right. Yeah, yeah. He did. He and I did La Fay both played. Julian Lane, he died too. Yeah. He played a lot of T-God type of stuff.…
